claim: Patchline ships a grand-unified evidence index proving formal core, scale, causal rigor, autonomy, adoption, and reproducibility in one command. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the grand-unified evidence index claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make grand-unified-evidence-index-2-gate`.
